about.title: About
about.body: {app} shows the Hebrew Old Testament and the Greek New Testament word by word: each word with its Hindi meaning, Devanagari pronunciation, grammar and Strong’s number, with the IRV Hindi translation under every verse. Free and ad-supported.
about.heb: Hebrew text: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (OSHB / morphhb), based on the Westminster Leningrad Codex — lemmas & morphology CC BY 4.0, WLC text public domain.
about.lex: Lexicon: Strong’s Hebrew Dictionary (public domain), from the Open Scriptures Hebrew Lexicon.
about.irv: Hindi verses: Indian Revised Version (IRV) Hindi – 2019, © 2017, 2018, 2019 Bridge Connectivity Solutions Pvt. Ltd., licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (eBible.org). Footnotes and cross-references removed; no other changes.
about.ours: Devanagari pronunciation, Hindi word meanings and grammar notes were added by this project (CC BY-SA 4.0); many meanings are generated automatically and are still being reviewed. The original licensors do not necessarily endorse these changes.
about.fonts: Fonts: Inter, Noto Serif Hebrew, Noto Serif Greek, Noto Sans Devanagari (SIL OFL).
about.gnt: Greek text: OpenGNT (Open Greek New Testament, Eliran Wong) — text, lemmas & morphology CC BY-SA 4.0. Greek lexicon: Strong’s Greek Dictionary (public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures, CC BY-SA).

faq: Where do the Hindi meanings come from?
Every Hebrew root word (lemma) has a Hindi meaning written in IRV vocabulary. Prefixes (व = and, ब = in…) and suffixes (his, my…) are combined to give each word its meaning in context.
What do the coloured letters mean?

In Hebrew, prefixes attached to the front of a word (such as וְ “and”, בְּ “in”) are shown in teal and pronoun suffixes in violet, so you can see the parts of each word. You can turn this off in Settings.
How does the New Testament work?

Switch to “New Testament” in the book picker or on Home. Each Greek word (OpenGNT) shows its Hindi meaning, a Devanagari pronunciation (Erasmian, as taught in Indian seminaries), its grammar and its Strong’s G-number. Double-tap for the Greek lexicon and concordance.
What are · and - in the pronunciation?
· separates syllables; - separates a prefix from the main word (वे-ख़ोल = “and all”).
An optional morphology code (e.g. N-mpc | 3ms = noun, masculine plural construct + his). Turn it on in Settings › Word display.
The Android app contains the whole Bible. On the web, chapters you read are saved automatically.
